title: PHASE 4 — executed value provenance (BCM4352 rev42 operational path)

writers: wlc_phy_attach @0xbeff8: mov %al,0x16e(%rbx), al=(edx>>0x14)&0xff (AC path, phytype==0xb); edx=(r13d<<16)|r14d; r13d,r14d = 16-bit reads of *(pi+0x148)+0x3da (= si_radio reg 0x3da) after writes to +0x3d8
values.initialization_order: pi is memset-zero, then wlc_phy_attach decodes the radio chip revision from radio register 0x3da and stores the major revision byte to pi+0x16e; this runs before wlc_phy_init's first radio-ON
values.board_phyrev_chanspec_dependency: HARDWARE (radio register 0x3da read); phytype 0xb selects the AC decode path
values.value_at_first_bringup_callsite: UNKNOWN (hardware-derived; radio reg 0x3da bits 4..11). NOT statically determinable.
consumers: wlc_phy_switch_radio_acphy @0xaa7c0 branch: ==1 -> PLL seq A, ==2 -> PLL seq B, else skip

values.identity: AC PHY rxcore state (byte); set from the wlc_phy_rxcore_setstate_acphy state argument
values.initialization_order: written by the callee immediately before the read (same function)
values.value_at_first_bringup_callsite: UNKNOWN (runtime rxcore state argument at the first cal)

values.identity: AC PHY per-chain STF/temp-throttle value byte 0 of the 2-byte array at +0x8be; NOT pi+0x8be directly (base is *(pi+0x138), a 0x920 heap sub-object)
writers: sub_a7089 @0xaa364: mov %dl,0x8be(%r15) with `inc %r15` (loop iteration 0), from stack array arr1[0]=0x19
values.initialization_order: sub-object osl_memset(0,0x920) at wlc_phy_attach_acphy; producer loop writes 0x19 before the consumer read (later invocation)
values.board_phyrev_chanspec_dependency: producer gated on chanspec low byte == 0x0d (channel 13); value itself is a constant

values.identity: AC PHY per-chain STF/temp-throttle value byte 1 of the 2-byte array at +0x8be; NOT pi+0x8bf directly (base is *(pi+0x138), a 0x920 heap sub-object) — RESOLVED M3.4D4 (D4-BLOCKER-PI-8BF)
writers: sub_a7089 @0xaa364: mov %dl,0x8be(%r15) with `inc %r15` (loop iteration 1) -> effective address base+0x8bf, from stack array arr1[1]=0x1a
values.initialization_order: sub-object osl_memset(0,0x920) at wlc_phy_attach_acphy; producer loop writes 0x1a before the consumer read (later invocation)
values.board_phyrev_chanspec_dependency: producer gated on chanspec low byte == 0x0d (channel 13); value itself is a constant
values.value_at_first_bringup_callsite: 0x1a (26) — whenever the read executes, because the read is gated on the producer having run

values.identity: static coefficient tables in .data (4428 bytes each): rx_farrow_tbl, rx_farrow_tbl_rev3, rx_farrow_tbl_40_rev3, tx_farrow_dac1_tbl, tx_farrow_dac1_tbl_rev3, tx_farrow_dac1_tbl_40_rev3, tx_farrow_dac2_tbl, tx_farrow_dac3_tbl
values.board_phyrev_chanspec_dependency: table SELECTION is runtime (chip id `acphychipid` (.bss) + phyrev/rev3 + rodata tables); coefficient VALUES are static
values.value_at_first_bringup_callsite: static table contents; selected index/data runtime

summary.note: The earlier apparent set of pi+0x16e writers {0,1,2} were `cmpb` READS misclassified as stores; the real store is wlc_phy_attach's radio-revision decode (hardware) plus one LPPHY 16-bit store. (pi+0x8be/0x8bf) were previously 'no store / COMPUTED_RUNTIME'; they are actually written by the incrementing-pointer loop sub_a7089 @0xaa364 from the constant stack array {0x19,0x1a} -> +0x8be=0x19, +0x8bf=0x1a (see pi_8bf_provenance.md).
